name: The Stack v3 (train)
license: odc-by (dataset card); per-file source licenses recorded in license_type (permissive or no_license) and detected_licenses
size: Training subset: 15.9 TB of source code, 713 languages, 173M repos, ~3.6T tokens (v3.1). Full corpus: 113.7 TB, 770 languages, 224M repos
summary: Successor to The Stack v2: a direct GitHub crawl (cutoff 2025-08-07) with file contents inline, grouped by repository, near-deduplicated, quality filtered and PII redacted. Built for repo-level code pretraining.
how_to_use: Default open starting point for a fresh code pretraining run with repo context. Stream it first; there are no per-language configs, so filter files[].language yourself.
caveats: Not gated, unlike v2. Files labeled no_license are included (non_permissive are excluded), so check your own policy on unlicensed code. Opt-out via Am I in The Stack, applied before each patch release. Excludes issues, PRs, Kaggle and docs that came with StarCoder2. v3.1 removed exact duplicates (4.9T to 3.6T tokens), so pin the version. stack-v3-full is an HF bucket, not a dataset, and is huge. Possible overlap with benchmark repos: decontaminate.
load_snippet:
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("HuggingFaceCode/stack-v3-train", split="train", streaming=True)
for repo in ds:
    print(repo["repo_path"], repo["num_files"]); break
evidence: huggingface.co/api/datasets/HuggingFaceCode/stack-v3-train cardData.license=odc-by; dataset card README (sizes, license_type, pipeline)

name: The Stack v2

extra_links.label: StarCoder 2 and The Stack v2 paper

License labels are heuristic (ScanCode), license laundering exists. Opt-outs only honored as of release date. Superseded by v3 for fresher data. Card could not be read without login, so sizes cite the v3 card.

name: Stack-Edu
license: not stated in dataset card (HF license field unset); underlying files are permissively licensed StarCoder2Data (see license_type and detected_licenses columns)

summary: Educational-quality subset of StarCoder2Data, selected with language-specific classifiers (score and int_score columns), built for SmolLM2. Ships blob ids, not file text.
how_to_use: Filter by int_score (check the SmolLM2 paper for the threshold used) and fetch content from Software Heritage by blob_id. Quality-over-quantity code source for mid-training and small models.
caveats: Contains blob_id and metadata only; you must download file contents from Software Heritage S3. License inherited per file. Classifier labels are LLM-annotated and noisy at the margin. Only 15 languages.

name: SmolLM-Corpus (Python-Edu, Cosmopedia, FineWeb-Edu-Dedup)

how_to_use: Use python-edu as a compact high-quality Python source; Cosmopedia adds synthetic textbook text.
caveats: Python only for code; Cosmopedia is synthetic from Mixtral, with that model's terms. Superseded for code by Stack-Edu. Python-edu includes file text; license inherited from source repos.

caveats: Synthetic parts were generated by LLMs (check the paper for which). Algorithmic subset is derived from Stack v2, with per-file license caveats. Token counts not stated in card.

name: datasketch

how_to_use: Building block for custom MinHash-LSH dedup (the method used for Stack v2/v3 near-dedup).

name: duplodocus
summary: Ai2 Rust CLI for exact and MinHash dedup over large JSONL datasets.

name: decon (Ai2)
summary: Token-based decontamination tool that finds training documents containing eval instances and writes reports and cleaned datasets.
how_to_use: Run after dedup; load your eval sets (HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench etc.) and drop or report hits.
caveats: Young project; coverage depends on the eval files you supply and on n-gram sampling settings.

summary: Ai2 data toolkit: fast Rust tagger/mixer, Bloom filter dedup and mixing used for OLMo corpora.

name: Data-Juicer
summary: One-stop data processing system with 100+ operators for text, code and multimodal data, including code filters and dedup.
how_to_use: Use when you want a configurable operator pipeline with built-in analysis.
caveats: Large surface area; verify operator quality on your code data.

name: DCLM (DataComp-LM)
